column1: # v2.9.0 (WP-P3b) -- known shipped content for the 7 dashboard files retired in WP-N1
# Used ONLY by install.ps1/install.sh's pre-2.8.0 (no-manifest) legacy fallback, to migrate a project
# that never had install-manifest tracking at all -- a 2.8.0+ install is pruned by its own manifest
# Format: <path relative to a directory that has .claude/ directly under it><TAB><sha256, lowercase>
# Each sha256 is of the file's content with CRLF normalized to LF (a lone CR or LF is left
# untouched) -- see Get-ForgeNormalizedSha256 / forge_sha256_normalized. One line per historical
# shipped version of that path; several lines legitimately share the same path.
# Recomputed straight from this repo's own git history (git log --all -- <path>, then the blob at
# each commit) by tests/installer/assert-retired-dashboard-hashes.js, which FAILS the build if this
# table ever drifts from what git actually recorded. 21 lines total, matching that recompute exactly.
